messages:
sam_cs: Quick heads-up 11 DeltaGrid onboarding failing in CI with 429 bursts when running their parallel matrix (6 runners). They see preflight + auth storms.

lee_eng: Can you paste the exact response they got?

sam_cs: Snippet from their action logs:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 09:12:01 GMT
Retry-After: 4
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","reason":"preflight_concurrency"}
```
They also reported `401` spikes when ephemeral tokens rotate.

toni_onboard: Sounds like each runner mints tokens + does preflight. That's 2x per runner. Recommend central mint + token-share or a single preflight leader.

lee_eng: Short fixes to suggest: 1) use a job-level token issuer step that writes token to workspace, 2) stagger runner start by 200-800ms, 3) honor Retry-After and use jittered exponential backoff, 4) request a temporary dev-burst if they need immediate parallelism.

sam_cs: Example GitHub Actions pattern I shared:
```yaml
- name: Mint token (producer)
  run: |
    echo "$(mint-token)" > token.txt
  if: matrix.role == 'issuer'
- name: Read token
  run: |
    TOKEN=$(cat token.txt)
    export TOKEN
  needs: mint
```

alexa_pm: Renewal risk: DeltaGrid has a customer POC next week; if CI stays flaky it's a risk. Scheduling an enablement call tomorrow 14:00 UTC.

lee_eng: For leftover 401s: implement a small overlap when rotating tokens (issue new token a few seconds before expiry) and use a leader-election or lockfile for mint. Also check clock skew.

ci-bot: Created ticket CS-ONBOARD-3499 for DeltaGrid CI preflight 429s (priority: high).

toni_onboard: I'll add a tiny reference snippet to the onboarding docs and a sample repo demonstrating the token-producer pattern.

sam_cs: Customer tried the token-producer + stagger fix; 5 CI runs clean, one transient 401 resolved by retry. I'll keep monitoring and update CS-ONBOARD-3499. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
